title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
title_zh: SepGen：单模型实现的多音轨音频视频分离与生成

paragraphs.en: A 4D audio-visual scene comprises a video, the dynamic geometry it depicts, and the sound sources that populate it, each with its own position and trajectory. Rendering such a scene from a novel viewpoint requires that every source be available as an individual waveform, so that it can be localized in the scene and propagated to the observer before the signals are mixed. Joint audio-video generators can synthesize the video and its soundtrack, but the soundtrack is emitted as a single audio-mix in which the sources are not individually accessible. We present SepGen, which extends a pretrained audio-video generator to emit the video, the mixed soundtrack, and one waveform per captioned source in one joint sampling run. SepGen supports two complementary modes: generation and separation. In generation mode, each source caption specifies what its stem contains. A two-speaker dialogue, for example, comes out as one stem per speaker in the original turn order. In separation mode, the input audio-mix remains clean while the captions specify what to extract, so the model can decompose a recording from a free-text description. We evaluate generation on scenes synthesized from text, and separation on scenes rendered by other generators and on real recordings of speech, music, and sound effects. Given an audio-mix and captions that carry the spoken lines, SepGen outperforms language-conditioned separators, most clearly on speech, and it keeps the lead when the lines are removed from the captions. Code, checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://sepgen.github.io/ .
paragraphs.zh: 一个四维视听场景包含一段视频、其描绘的动态几何结构以及其中的声源，每个声源都有各自的位置和轨迹。 要从新的视角渲染这样的场景，需要每个声源都以独立的波形形式存在，以便在场景中定位并将其传播到观察者处，之后再将信号混合。 联合音视频生成器可以合成视频及其配乐，但配乐是以单一音频混合信号的形式输出的，其中各个声源无法单独获取。 我们提出了 SepGen，它扩展了一个预训练的音视频生成器，能够在一次联合采样运行中同时输出视频、混合配乐以及每个带标题的声源对应的波形。 SepGen 支持两种互补的模式：生成和分离。 在生成模式下，每个声源的标题会指定其音轨包含的内容。 例如，一段双人对白会以原始发言顺序的形式，按发言人分别输出为独立的音轨。 在分离模式下，输入的音频混合信号保持纯净，而标题则指定了需要提取的内容，因此模型能够根据自由文本描述分解录音内容。 我们在通过文本合成的场景上评估了生成能力，并在由其他生成器渲染的场景以及包含语音、音乐和音效的真实录音上评估了分离能力。 给定一个音频混合信号和包含对话内容的标题，SepGen 的表现优于语言条件化的分离模型，尤其在语音部分表现最为显著；即使将对话内容从标题中移除，它仍能保持领先优势。 代码、检查点和数据集可在 https://sepgen.github.io/ 获取。

paragraphs.en: Recent joint audio-video generators ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ; Low et al., 2025 ) synthesize video with synchronized sound, but output the entire scene as one waveform, the audio-mix , whose sources cannot be moved, removed, or rerendered individually. Language-queried separation ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) can estimate a described source afterward, but requires an additional model run and handles each caption in isolation, which fails when two sources belong to the same category: asked separately for each of two men speaking, it might return the same speaker.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的联合音视频生成器（HaCohen 等，2026；Low 等，2025）能够合成带有同步声音的视频，但会将整个场景作为单一的波形——即音频混合信号——输出，其各个声源无法被单独移动、移除或重新渲染。 语言查询分离技术（Liu 等，2025；Yuan 等，2025；Shi 等，2025）虽然可以事后估计出所描述的声源，但需要额外运行一次模型，并且对每个字幕进行独立处理；当两个声源属于同一类别时，这种方法就会失效：例如，若分别询问两个说话男子的信息，该技术可能会返回同一个说话人。

paragraphs.en: Per-source waveforms matter most when the scene itself is rerendered. Monocular video methods lift a video to a 4D scene that can be viewed from a new camera pose ( Karhade et al., 2026 ; Litman et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and spatial audio renderers propagate each source to the observer ( Chen et al., 2020a ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2023 ) . An audio-mix recorded at the original pose, however, exposes no source to place, so the sound stays fixed (Figure 1 a).
paragraphs.zh: 当场景本身被重新渲染时，原始声源波形最为关键。 单目视频方法可将视频升维为一个 4D 场景，从而可以从新的相机姿态进行观察（Karhade 等，2026；Litman 等，2026；Zhang 等，2025），而空间音频渲染器则会将每个声源传播到观察者位置（Chen 等，2020a；Xie 等，2026；Jin 等，2026；Liang 等，2023）。 然而，在原始姿态下录制的音频混音并未暴露任何声源的位置，因此声音会保持固定不变（图 1a）。

paragraphs.en: We present SepGen, an audio-video generator that also outputs each source: from a scene caption and one caption per source, it produces the video, the audio-mix, and one waveform per source, a stem , in a single sampling run (Figure ). Predicting both stems jointly from the shared audio-mix lets each follow its own caption while sharing the scene’s timing, and yields the per-source waveforms that a spatial renderer requires (Figure 1 b).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SepGen，这是一种音视频生成器，它还能输出每个音源：通过场景描述和每个音源的单独描述，它能在单次采样运行中生成视频、音频混音以及每个音源的一个波形（即一个音轨）（图）。 从共享的音频混音中联合预测所有音轨，能让每个音轨遵循其自身的描述，同时共享场景的时间同步信息，并生成空间渲染器所需的各音源波形（图 1b）。

paragraphs.en: Adding stems to a pretrained backbone must not disturb what the backbone already produces. SepGen therefore appends the two stems to the backbone’s audio sequence as additional channels, trained through a low-rank audio adapter, and keeps the audio-mix as a protected channel that attends only to itself and bypasses the adapter, so the backbone’s soundtrack and video are unchanged while the stems attend to the audio-mix and to each other at aligned rotary positions. The stems must also stay apart from each other: block-diagonal caption routing gives each stem only its own caption, and Cross-Stem Attention Guidance steers it away from its sibling’s. The same model can either generate a scene together with its stems, or separate the stems from an observed scene. Since the backbone is a denoising model, the noise level of the audio-mix selects between the two: separation holds the observed audio-mix at zero noise, whereas generation denoises it together with the stems, which then attend to its current denoised estimate (Estimated Separation). We therefore train on separation first and briefly continue on noisy audio-mixes, yielding one checkpoint that does both.
paragraphs.zh: 向预训练主干网络添加声源成分时，绝不能干扰主干网络已有的输出。 因此，SepGen 将两个声源成分作为额外通道附加到主干网络的音频序列中，并通过低秩音频适配器进行训练；同时保留音频混合信号作为一个受保护的通道，该通道仅关注自身并绕过适配器，从而确保主干网络的音轨和视频保持不变，而各声源成分则能在对齐的旋转位置上关注音频混合信号彼此之间。 各声源成分之间也必须保持独立：块对角式标题路由使每个声源成分仅获得其自身的标题，而跨声源注意力引导则使其偏离其他声源成分的标题。 同一模型既可以与声源成分一起生成场景，也可以从已观察到的场景中分离出这些声源成分。 由于主干网络是一个去噪模型，音频混合信号的噪声水平决定了两种模式之间的选择：分离模式将已观察到的音频混合信号保持在零噪声状态，而生成模式则将其与声源成分一同进行去噪，此时各声源成分会关注当前去噪后的估计值（估计分离结果）。 因此，我们首先使用分离任务进行训练，然后短暂地继续训练于含噪的音频混合信号，最终得到一个同时具备这两种能力的检查点模型。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are: (i) SepGen, to our knowledge the first framework that turns a pretrained joint audio-video generator into a multi-stem generator, emitting the video, its soundtrack, and one waveform per captioned source in a single sampling run. (ii) Mechanisms that keep the stems caption-faithful and the pretrained output intact: a protected audio-mix channel that bypasses the adapter, aligned rotary positions, block-diagonal caption routing, and a schedule in which the stems attend to the estimated clean audio-mix. (iii) A single set of weights for both modes, selected by the audio-mix noise level: a separation-trained checkpoint already generates stems, and a brief continuation reduces leakage between the generated stems, improves speech intelligibility, and stabilizes results across seeds, while preserving separation. We evaluate both modes on generated, cross-generator, and real scenes, with automatic metrics and a human A/B study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献包括：(i) SepGen，据我们所知，这是首个将预训练的联合音视频生成器转化为多声源生成器的框架，它能在单次采样运行中输出视频、其配乐以及每个带字幕的声源对应的波形。 (ii) 确保各声源与字幕保持一致且预训练输出不受破坏的机制：一个绕过适配器的受保护音频混合通道、对齐的旋转位置、块对角字幕路由，以及一个让各声源关注估计出的纯净音频混合的调度方案。 (iii) 适用于两种模式的一组统一权重，由音频混合的噪声水平决定：经过分离训练的检查点本身即可生成声源，而短暂的延续操作能减少生成声源之间的泄漏、提升语音清晰度，并在不同随机种子下稳定结果，同时保持分离效果。 我们在生成的场景、跨生成器的场景以及真实场景中，通过自动评估指标和人类 A/B 对比研究对两种模式进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Joint audio-video generation. Joint audio-video generators synthesize a video and its synchronized soundtrack from text, either by coupling two modality streams, as in LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) , our backbone’s family, and Ovi ( Low et al., 2025 ) , or by bridging separately pretrained generators ( Xing et al., 2024 ) . Proprietary systems such as Veo 3.1 Lite ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , which renders our Veo benchmark, also generate video and audio jointly. Video-to-audio (V2A) models add a soundtrack to an existing video ( Polyak et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Shan et al., 2025 ; Viertola et al., 2025 ; Tao et al., 2026 ) . All of them output one audio-mix per scene, whereas SepGen outputs a separate waveform for each source, in both of its modes. Like prior LoRA adaptations of such generators ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Huang et al., 2024b ; Dahan et al., 2026 ) , SepGen adapts its backbone, but its extra audio tracks are captioned stems that neither the video nor the audio-mix attends to, and the audio-mix bypasses the LoRA (Section 3 ). Its Cross-Stem Attention Guidance (Section 3 ) adapts Normalized Attention Guidance ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , with the sibling caption as the negative prompt.

paragraphs.en: Multi-source audio generation. Multi-source models emit several stems at once. In music, MSDM ( Mariani et al., 2023 ) and its latent and text-conditioned extensions ( Karchkhadze et al., 2025 ; Postolache et al., 2024 ) generate and separate stems, and other models generate, add, or text-specify stems ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Rouard et al., 2025 ; Parker et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Closest to ours, MGE-LDM ( Chae and Lee, 2025 ) switches between generation and extraction by choosing which tracks to denoise, like our two modes, but is audio-only and extracts one source per run. Given a video, other models generate one clip per detected source, speech and background tracks, one track per event, or only a text-selected source ( Dagli et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Hayakawa et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , or fuse detected sources into one audio-mix ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . To our knowledge, no method generates a video with several captioned stems in one denoising run.
paragraphs.zh: 多源音频生成。 多源模型会同时输出多个音轨。 在音乐领域，MSDM（Mariani 等人，2023）及其潜在和文本条件扩展模型（Karchkhadze 等人，2025；Postolache 等人，2024）能够生成并分离音轨，而其他模型则能生成、添加或通过文本指定音轨（Xu 等人，2024；Yao 等人，2025；Rouard 等人，2025；Parker 等人，2024；Wu 等人，2026）。 与我们的方法最接近的是 MGE-LDM（Chae 和 Lee，2025），它通过选择需要降噪的音轨在生成与提取模式之间切换，类似于我们的两种模式，但该模型仅处理音频，且每次运行只能提取一个音源。 给定一段视频，其他模型会针对每个检测到的音源（包括语音和背景音轨）生成一个片段，或为每个事件生成一个音轨，或仅生成文本选定的音源（Dagli 等人，2025；Tian 等人，2025；Hayakawa 等人，2026；Lee 等人，2026），或者将检测到的多个音源融合为一个混合音频（Guo 等人，2026）。 据我们所知，目前没有任何方法能在单次降噪运行中生成包含多个带字幕音轨的视频。

paragraphs.en: Language-queried source separation. Query-conditioned separation extracts from an audio-mix only the source specified by a query, such as text, a visual region, or an audio example. Language-queried audio source separation (LASS) uses free-form text ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Dong et al., 2022 ) . Our cascade baselines (Section 4.1 ) are three released LASS models. AudioSep ( Liu et al., 2025 ) conditions a separation network on CLAP text embeddings ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , FlowSep ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) is a rectified-flow generative separator, and SAM Audio ( Shi et al., 2025 ) is a flow-matching transformer that also accepts visual-mask and time-span prompts. We do not compare with the recent FlowSep 2 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , whose models were unreleased at the time of writing. Other separators vary the query encoder or network ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , parse sources with a large language model ( Mahmud and Marculescu, 2024 ) , combine text, image, and audio queries ( Cheng et al., 2025b ) , extract several sources in one pass but only from fixed categories ( Saijo et al., 2025 ; Paissan et al., 2025 ) , or reuse pretrained text-to-audio diffusion models without separation training ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 语言查询源分离。 查询条件分离技术仅从音频混合信号中提取由查询指定的声源，例如文本、视觉区域或音频示例。 语言查询音频源分离（LASS）使用自由形式文本（Liu et al., 2022；Dong et al., 2022）。 我们的级联基线模型（第 4.1 节）是三个已发布的 LASS 模型。 AudioSep（Liu et al., 2025）通过 CLAP 文本嵌入（Wu et al., 2023）对分离网络进行条件约束；FlowSep（Yuan et al., 2025）是一种基于修正流的生成式分离器；而 SAM Audio（Shi et al., 2025）则是一种流匹配变换器，同时支持视觉掩码和时间跨度提示。 我们没有与近期的 FlowSep 2（Yuan et al., 2026）进行比较，因为撰写本文时其模型尚未发布。 其他分离器通过改变查询编码器或网络结构（Ma et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025a）、使用大型语言模型解析声源（Mahmud and Marculescu, 2024）、结合文本、图像和音频查询（Cheng et al., 2025b）、单次处理提取多个声源但仅限于固定类别（Saijo et al., 2025；Paissan et al., 2025），或复用未经分离训练的预训练文本到音频扩散模型（Huang et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2025）来实现不同功能。

paragraphs.en: Audio-visual and generative separation. Targets can also be specified by sounding objects or musicians’ motion ( Zhao et al., 2018 ; Gao and Grauman, 2019 ; Gan et al., 2020 ) , speakers’ faces ( Ephrat et al., 2018 ; Gao and Grauman, 2021 ) , or a typed speaker description ( Hao et al., 2025 ) . Generative separators exist for speech ( Scheibler et al., 2023 ) , audio-visual mixes ( Huang et al., 2024a ) , and film audio with fixed speech, music, and effects stems ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . MMAudioSep ( Takahashi et al., 2026 ) turns a video-to-audio model into a separator that can still generate, but extracts one source per pass. Since query-based separators process each query independently, queries for two speakers can both return the louder voice (Section 1 ); SepGen instead predicts both stems jointly from the shared audio-mix.
paragraphs.zh: 视听与生成式分离。 目标也可以通过发声物体或音乐家的动作（Zhao 等，2018；Gao 和 Grauman，2019；Gan 等，2020）、说话者的面部（Ephrat 等，2018；Gao 和 Grauman，2021），或输入文本形式的说话者描述（Hao 等，2025）来指定。 现有的生成式分离方法包括语音分离（Scheibler 等，2023）、视听混合信号分离（Huang 等，2024a），以及包含固定语音、音乐和音效轨道的电影音频分离（Zhang 等，2026）。 MMAudioSep（Takahashi 等，2026）将视频转音频模型转化为一个仍具备生成能力的分离器，但每次仅提取一个声源。 由于基于查询的分离器会独立处理每个查询，因此对两位说话者的查询可能都会返回更响亮的声音（第 1 节）；而 SepGen 则从共享的音频混合信号中联合预测两个声轨。

paragraphs.en: Problem Formulation. Let F F denote a flow matching diffusion audio-video generator with two transformer streams, one for the video tokens and one for the audio tokens, e.g. LTX-2.5 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) . In every block, each stream self-attends over its own tokens and cross-attends to the conditioning scene caption c c . Additionally, the two streams exchange information through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention. Denoising both latents jointly and decoding them yields a video V V and its audio-mix m m , ( V , m ) = F ⁡ ( c ) (V,m)=F(c) . For brevity, V V denotes both the video and its latent.
paragraphs.zh: 问题构建。 令 F F 表示一个具有两个 Transformer 流（一个用于视频标记，一个用于音频标记）的流匹配扩散音视频生成器，例如： LTX-2.5（HaCohen 等，2026）。 在每个块中，每个流都会对其自身的标记进行自注意力计算，并对条件场景描述 c c 进行交叉注意力计算。 此外，两个流通过双向音频视频交叉注意力交换信息。 联合去噪两个潜在表示并对其进行解码，可得到视频 V V 及其音频混合信号 m m，即 (V, m) = F(c)。 为简洁起见，V V 同时表示视频及其潜在表示。

paragraphs.en: Training data. Each training example consists of a video, its audio-mix, the waveform of each of its two sources, a scene caption, and a caption per source. We assemble 4,843 such examples from four origins: CelebV-HQ ( Zhu et al., 2022 ) , URMP ( Li et al., 2019 ) , two-source scenes that we generate, and synthetic audio-mixes that combine clips from different VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020b ) videos and MUSIC-21 ( Zhao et al., 2019 ) solo performances. The two sources of an example may sound at the same time or alternate, as in a dialogue where the speakers take turns. Each example has up to three sets of captions at different verbosity levels, and each training step draws one set at random. Appendix A describes this process in detail.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks and baselines. Generation. For the generation task, we curate 194 two-source scene prompts (134 sound scenes and 60 two-speaker dialogues) using Claude for a draft and manually approving each prompt. For each prompt, the generation checkpoint generates the video, the audio-mix, and one stem per source caption; each baseline then receives this generated audio-mix and separates the same two captions from it. Separation. For separation, we curate two benchmarks of rendered scenes: 149 scenes rendered by Veo 3.1 Lite and 64 scenes rendered by LTX-2.3. We further evaluate on 172 real recordings from SAM-Audio-bench, each with a single queried source. In this benchmark, SepGen receives the queried source as q 1 q_{1} and a fixed caption describing the residual background as q 2 q_{2} , the swap margins score the target stem against the list of the other sound events annotated in the clip, and the speech recordings, which have no transcripts, are scored with Judge and CLAP. In every case, the input is an existing video with its audio-mix, and every method, including both checkpoints of SepGen, extracts the captioned sources from it. We compare with FlowSep ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , AudioSep ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and the two released SAM Audio checkpoints ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , SAM large and SAM large-tv. paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports SepGen in two configurations: the stems of the generation run itself (joint run), and a second run of the same weights in separation mode over the generated video and audio-mix, with the same captions (self-separation). The joint-run stems lead every cascade baseline on every metric, significantly except for CLAP against FlowSep and against AudioSep, whose query encoder is the scorer’s CLAP checkpoint (Holm-corrected paired tests, Appendix Table S4 ). The widest lead is in J-swap: the two stems are generated jointly and each is bound to its caption, whereas a cascade answers each query in isolation and can return the same source twice. Self-separation raises every sounds column at the cost of a second sampling run, while the joint-run stems keep a lower own-line word error, within seed variation. The summed stems also match the audio-mix more closely than those of any cascade (Appendix Table S14 ). In the generated scene of Figure 3 , the video attention of each stem concentrates on the source named in its caption. Per-category results are in Appendix Table S5 and qualitative examples in Appendix Figure S2 .

Veo benchmark. Both checkpoints surpass every cascade baseline in Table 2 on Judge and both swap margins, and prompting SAM large-tv with SAM3 video masks instead of text (SA × \times SAM3) does not close the gap. A cascade’s query encoder cannot exploit the quoted line in a speech caption, so each speech cell also reports every method with all quoted lines removed (second value); the lead persists. Without the lines, 4 to 5 of the 90 stems fall silent, which partly explains why speaker cosine improves while word error rises. A dedicated speech separator, SepFormer ( Subakan et al., 2021 ) , matches the separation checkpoint only when the quoted lines are removed (Table 2 and Appendix Table S11 ). SAM Audio’s released pipeline also samples eight candidates per query and keeps the one with the highest Judge and CLAP scores, a post-processing step absent from the other methods. Applying it to SepGen and both SAM Audio checkpoints leaves a significant Judge gap, and the speech measures, which the reranker does not select on, stay far apart (Appendix Table S8 ). paragraphs.en: Limitations. The audio VAE decoder keeps each stem’s envelope and spectrum and regenerates its phase, so SI-SDR against a reference waveform measures that phase resynthesis (Appendix F ). The current layout is fixed at two sources. The stems keep the acoustics of the scene they come from, including reverberation and distance cues, so a spatial renderer must account for them before propagating each source to a new viewpoint.

paragraphs.en: Conclusion. SepGen allows a pretrained audio-video generator to produce per-source waveforms alongside its video and soundtrack, by training a lightweight stem adapter on paired two-source data and switching between separation and generation through the audio-mix noise schedule alone. The stems are free-text addressed, jointly denoised, and grounded in a protected audio-mix that the backbone produces unmodified. Future work includes extending the layout beyond two stems, and evaluating a placement readout from each stem’s video attention (Appendix G ) and integrating it into a spatial renderer for the 4D scenes that motivate this work. The project page ( https://sepgen.github.io/ ) shows audio-video examples of both modes beside the baselines, and an explainer video.
paragraphs.zh: 结论。 SepGen 允许预训练的音视频生成器在生成视频和音轨的同时，为每个音源生成独立的波形。其方法是在配对的双音源数据上训练一个轻量级的音源适配器，并仅通过音频混合噪声调度在分离与生成模式之间切换。 这些音源以自由文本形式指定，经过联合降噪处理，并以受保护的音频混合为基础，而该混合由主干网络未经修改地直接生成。 未来的工作包括将布局扩展到两个音源以上，评估从每个音源的视觉注意力中读取位置信息（附录 G），并将其整合到空间渲染器中，以生成驱动本研究的四维场景。 项目页面（https://sepgen.github.io/）展示了两种模式下的音视频示例，并与基线方法并列呈现，同时附有一段说明视频。

paragraphs.en: Training uses 4,843 two-source segments from four families: CelebV-HQ talking-head pairs ( n = 1,658 n{=}1{,}658 ) ( Zhu et al., 2022 ) , URMP two-instrument scenes ( n = 1,437 n{=}1{,}437 ) ( Li et al., 2019 ) , generated two-source clips ( n = 749 n{=}749 ), and cross-video composites ( n = 999 n{=}999 ) of VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020b ) and MUSIC-21 ( Zhao et al., 2019 ) clips. Ground-truth stems exist in every family because each audio-mix is the sum of two known sources: URMP provides per-instrument tracks, and the other families mix two single-source clips (two single-speaker recordings, two clips synthesized by our model, or two web clips placed as split-screen panels or with one source off screen). Each source caption comes in three registers, semantic, positional, and short, sampled with equal probability. Positional captions state where each source is located, and a source box , the frame region a source occupies in each video latent frame according to the composition records, enforces that statement during training through a soft additive bias that restricts each stem’s audio queries in video-to-audio attention to the video tokens inside its box. The bias is zeroed on the audio-mix channel and removed at inference, so no source location is supplied to the model when it separates. Since SAM-Audio-bench and three training families are YouTube clips, we verified that no video contributes to both: the 771 VGGSound, 170 MUSIC-21, and 133 CelebV-HQ training videos share no identifier with the 592 videos of the full SAM-Audio-bench release, and the benchmark’s VGGSound rows resolve in the same index as our training clips.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据使用了来自四个数据集的 4,843 个双源片段：CelebV-HQ 的说话者头部配对（n = 1,658 n{=}1{,}658）（Zhu 等人，2022）、URMP 的双乐器场景（n = 1,437 n{=}1{,}437）（Li 等人，2019）、生成的双源片段（n = 749 n{=}749），以及由 VGGSound（Chen 等人，2020b）和 MUSIC-21（Zhao 等人，2019）片段组成的跨视频合成片段（n = 999 n{=}999）。 每个数据集都存在真实参考音轨，因为每个音频混音都是两个已知声源之和：URMP 提供了每种乐器的独立音轨，而其他数据集则将两个单源片段进行混合（两个单扬声器录音、由我们的模型合成的两个片段，或作为分屏面板放置的两个网络片段，其中一个声源位于画面之外）。 每个声源的标注包含三种类型：语义标注、位置标注和简短标注，并以等概率进行采样。 位置标注说明了每个声源的具体位置；而“声源框”——即根据构图记录，声源在每个视频潜在帧中占据的图像区域——通过一种软性加法偏置在训练过程中强制执行这一信息，该偏置将每个音轨在视频到音频注意力机制中的音频查询限制在其声源框内的视频标记上。 这种偏置在音频混音通道上被置零，并在推理阶段移除，因此模型在进行分离时不会获得任何声源位置信息。 由于 SAM-Audio-bench 和三个训练数据集均包含 YouTube 片段，我们验证了没有任何一个视频同时出现在多个数据集中：771 个 VGGSound、170 个 MUSIC-21 和 133 个 CelebV-HQ 的训练视频与完整 SAM-Audio-bench 发布版本中的 592 个视频没有任何标识符重叠，并且该基准测试中 VGGSound 的行索引与我们训练片段中的索引一致。

sents.zh: 每个数据集都存在真实参考音轨，因为每个音频混音都是两个已知声源之和：URMP 提供了每种乐器的独立音轨，而其他数据集则将两个单源片段进行混合（两个单扬声器录音、由我们的模型合成的两个片段，或作为分屏面板放置的两个网络片段，其中一个声源位于画面之外）。

sents.en: Each source caption comes in three registers, semantic, positional, and short, sampled with equal probability.
sents.zh: 每个声源的标注包含三种类型：语义标注、位置标注和简短标注，并以等概率进行采样。

sents.en: Positional captions state where each source is located, and a source box , the frame region a source occupies in each video latent frame according to the composition records, enforces that statement during training through a soft additive bias that restricts each stem’s audio queries in video-to-audio attention to the video tokens inside its box.
sents.zh: 位置标注说明了每个声源的具体位置；而“声源框”——即根据构图记录，声源在每个视频潜在帧中占据的图像区域——通过一种软性加法偏置在训练过程中强制执行这一信息，该偏置将每个音轨在视频到音频注意力机制中的音频查询限制在其声源框内的视频标记上。

sents.en: The bias is zeroed on the audio-mix channel and removed at inference, so no source location is supplied to the model when it separates.
sents.zh: 这种偏置在音频混音通道上被置零，并在推理阶段移除，因此模型在进行分离时不会获得任何声源位置信息。

sents.en: Since SAM-Audio-bench and three training families are YouTube clips, we verified that no video contributes to both: the 771 VGGSound, 170 MUSIC-21, and 133 CelebV-HQ training videos share no identifier with the 592 videos of the full SAM-Audio-bench release, and the benchmark’s VGGSound rows resolve in the same index as our training clips.
sents.zh: 由于 SAM-Audio-bench 和三个训练数据集均包含 YouTube 片段，我们验证了没有任何一个视频同时出现在多个数据集中：771 个 VGGSound、170 个 MUSIC-21 和 133 个 CelebV-HQ 的训练视频与完整 SAM-Audio-bench 发布版本中的 592 个视频没有任何标识符重叠，并且该基准测试中 VGGSound 的行索引与我们训练片段中的索引一致。

paragraphs.en: Training runs in two stages, 12,000 separation updates followed by 3,000 generation updates, on the audio stream with the LTX-2.5 22B weights frozen and int8-quantized, on a single NVIDIA A6000: AdamW, batch size 1, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} with linear decay, bfloat16, LoRA rank and scale 128 ( Hu et al., 2021 ) on audio self-attention, the query and output projections of text cross-attention and video-to-audio attention, and the audio feed-forward block, 480 modules and 327M trainable parameters in total. Training segments are 113 frames at 25 fps encoded at 768 × 512 768\times 512 . The LoRA delta is zeroed on audio-mix tokens (the protected audio-mix of the main paper, Eq. ( 7 )) and the loss is computed on the stems alone. The separation stage presents the audio-mix clean ( σ = 0 \sigma{=}0 ) at every step; the generation stage presents it clean on 30% of samples and otherwise at an independent noise level clamped to that of the stems, σ m = min ⁡ ( σ m ′ , σ s ) \sigma_{m}=\min(\sigma^{\prime}_{m},\sigma_{s}) . At inference, video is encoded at 768 × 512 768\times 512 and each clip keeps its length (113 frames at 25 fps on the generation benchmark; 121, 137, and 241 frames at 24 fps on LTX-2.3, Veo, and SAM-Audio-bench). Generation adds an attention bias from stem queries to audio-mix keys, b 0 ​ ( 1 − ρ ) ​ U + b f ​ D w b_{0}(1-\rho)U+b_{f}D_{w} with b 0 = b f = 1 b_{0}{=}b_{f}{=}1 and w = 4 w{=}4 , where U U covers every audio-mix key, D w D_{w} the keys within w w latent frames of the query’s own time, and ρ \rho the fraction of the schedule elapsed, so the uniform term fades while the time-local band remains; once σ ≤ 0.97 \sigma\leq 0.97 , Estimated Separation (Section 3 of the main paper) conditions the stems on the clean estimate of the audio-mix. Each generation pass adds a second-stage spatial upscale and returns 1536 × 1024 1536\times 1024 video at 113 frames and 25 fps with three 48 kHz waveforms. Separation re-clamps the encoded audio-mix to σ = 0 \sigma{=}0 at every step. Guidance follows the LTX-2 pipeline defaults: classifier-free guidance (CFG) scales of 3.0 for video and 7.0 for audio, and, in generation, cross-modal guidance 3.0 on the video and audio-mix tracks; the stems receive no isolated-modality guidance in either mode. Separation uses 30 Euler steps with CFG rescale 0.7; generation uses the LTX pipeline’s 15-step res_2s sampler with video/audio-mix rescales 0.45/1.0 and stem rescale 0.7.
paragraphs.zh: 训练分为两个阶段：首先进行 12,000 次分离更新，随后进行 3,000 次生成更新。在音频流上，LTX-2.5 22B 模型权重保持冻结并进行 int8 量化，所有操作均在一块 NVIDIA A6000 显卡上执行。优化器为 AdamW，批量大小为 1，学习率设为 10⁻⁴ 并采用线性衰减，使用 bfloat16 精度。LoRA 的秩和缩放因子为 128（Hu et al., 2021），应用范围包括音频自注意力机制、文本交叉注意力的查询和输出投影、视频到音频注意力机制以及音频前馈网络模块，共包含 480 个模块和 3.27 亿个可训练参数。训练片段为 113 帧（25 fps），分辨率为 768×512。LoRA 的增量在音频混合令牌（主论文中受保护的音频混合信号，见公式 (7)）上被置零，损失函数仅基于各音轨单独计算。在分离阶段，每一步都将音频混合信号设为纯净状态（σ = 0）；在生成阶段，30% 的样本中音频混合信号保持纯净，其余样本则采用独立噪声水平，且该噪声水平被限制在与各音轨相同的范围内，即 σₘ = min(σ'ₘ, σₛ)。推理时，视频以 768×512 分辨率进行编码，每个剪辑片段保留其原始时长（生成基准测试中为 113 帧，25 fps；LTX-2.3、Veo 和 SAM-Audio-bench 中分别为 121、137 和 241 帧，24 fps）。生成过程会添加一种注意力偏差：从各音轨的查询向量到音频混合键的向量，形式为 b₀(1−ρ)U + b_fD_w，其中 b₀ = b_f = 1，w = 4。在此公式中，U 覆盖所有音频混合键，D_w 则包含查询向量自身时间窗口内 w 个潜在帧内的键，而 ρ 表示训练进度已完成的比例，因此均匀项会逐渐减弱，而时间局部带则保持不变；一旦 σ ≤ 0.97，估计分离结果（主论文第 3 节）便将各音轨的条件建立在纯净的音频混合估计值之上。每次生成过程都会添加第二阶段的空间上采样，最终输出分辨率为 1536×1024、帧率为 25 fps、共 113 帧的视频，并附带三条 48 kHz 的波形。分离阶段在每一步都将编码后的音频混合信号重新钳制至 σ = 0。引导机制遵循 LTX-2 流程的默认设置：视频的分类器自由引导（CFG）缩放因子为 3.0，音频为 7.0；在生成过程中，视频和音频混合轨道的跨模态引导因子为 3.0；两种模式下，各音轨均不接收独立模态的引导。分离过程使用 30 个欧拉步，CFG 重缩放因子为 0.7；生成过程则采用 LTX 流程中的 15 步 res_2s 采样器，视频和音频混合轨道的重缩放因子分别为 0.45 和 1.0，各音轨的重缩放因子为 0.7。

paragraphs.en: A denoising pass of the generation configuration is executed twice from identical inputs, with the adapter enabled and with all LoRA updates disabled, and the intermediate activations of each transformer block and the final outputs are compared. The audio-mix rows and the video are bit-identical between the two runs at every layer; the stem rows differ. Relative to a stock render from the same inputs, the audio-mix and video differ only through floating-point rounding, which arises from the text encoder’s batch composition, the batched guidance layout of the stock pipeline, and the timestep embedding computed over the three-track sequence, and, over a full render, through the sampler’s noise draw.
paragraphs.zh: 使用相同的输入，在启用适配器且所有 LoRA 更新均禁用的情况下，对生成配置执行两次去噪步骤，并比较每个 Transformer 块的中间激活值以及最终输出。 在每一层中，两次运行之间的音频混合行和视频都是逐位相同的；但 stem 行存在差异。 与使用相同输入的标准渲染结果相比，音频混合和视频的差异仅源于浮点数的舍入误差，这种误差由文本编码器的批处理组成、标准流程中的批量引导布局、基于三轨序列计算的时间步嵌入，以及在完整渲染过程中采样器的噪声抽取所引起。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation spans four benchmarks, three of generated videos, scored separately for sounds and speech, and one of real recordings, scored as one pool. On the generated benchmarks, speech captions consist of a role and a quoted line. Every language-queried method receives identical per-source captions ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) ; SA × \times SAM3 is SAM large-tv driven by SAM3 video masks, and its empty-mask stems (24 of the 298 Veo stems, 14 of the 74 LTX-2.3 sounds stems) are silent and remain in every mean.
paragraphs.zh: 评估涵盖四个基准测试：三个生成视频（声音和语音分别评分）以及一个真实录音（作为一个整体评分）。 在生成视频基准测试中，语音字幕由一个角色和一个引语组成。 每种语言查询方法都接收来自同一来源的相同字幕（Shi et al., 2025；Yuan et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025）；SA × \times SAM3 由 SAM3 视频掩码驱动的 SAM large-tv 模型实现，其空掩码音轨（298 个 Veo 音轨中的 24 个，74 个 LTX-2.3 声音音轨中的 14 个）是无声的，并且保留在每个均值中。

paragraphs.en: The generation benchmark comprises 194 two-source scene prompts: speech ( n = 60 n{=}60 ) and foley (59), music (45), and speech-with-background (30) as the sounds lane ( n = 134 n{=}134 ). Prompts were drafted with a large language model and approved manually, and no prompt string matches a training caption exactly or at a token-set Jaccard similarity of 0.8 or above. For each prompt, the generation checkpoint synthesizes the video, the audio-mix, and both stems in one sampling run; every cascade baseline then receives that audio-mix with the same two captions, and self-separation passes it through our separation pipeline. Scorer queries are fixed acoustic descriptions of each source, shared verbatim with the Veo benchmark. The generated audio-mixes carry the scripted lines: transcribed with the speech scorer’s recognizer, they read word error 0.05 against the two lines concatenated. Each clip lasts 4.5 s.

paragraphs.en: SAM-Audio-bench consists of in-the-wild YouTube recordings from AudioSet, AVSpeech, Condensed Movies, music duets, and VGGSound, each with one target description, a benchmark-provided 10 s window, and no reference stems. We score its instrument-wild, sound-effects, and speaker subsets, removing seven speech rows that duplicate another row’s video, window, and text, for 172 recordings (69 / 55 / 48). Every method is queried with the benchmark’s text adapted to our caption style; the cascade baselines are also scored with the native text (Table S10 ). SepGen writes two stems, the second describing the residual background; Judge and CLAP are reported on the queried target, and the swap-margin sibling text is drawn from the benchmark’s list of other sources present in the clip.

paragraphs.en: Let J ⁡ ( s , c ) J(s,c) denote the SAM Audio Judge overall rating of stem s s given description c c and the input audio-mix, and C ⁡ ( s , c ) C(s,c) the CLAP cosine between stem and description ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . For a clip with stems s 1 , s 2 s_{1},s_{2} and descriptions c 1 , c 2 c_{1},c_{2} , identity scores are J ⁡ ( s i , c i ) J(s_{i},c_{i}) and C ⁡ ( s i , c i ) C(s_{i},c_{i}) , and swap margins are J ⁡ ( s i , c i ) − J ⁡ ( s i , c j ) J(s_{i},c_{i})-J(s_{i},c_{j}) and C ⁡ ( s i , c i ) − C ⁡ ( s i , c j ) C(s_{i},c_{i})-C(s_{i},c_{j}) for j ≠ i j\neq i , averaged over both stems (J-swap, C-swap); a stem that copies the audio-mix obtains a margin of zero. Speech stems are scored by own-line word error, the word error rate of each stem’s transcript against its own speaker’s quoted line ( Radford et al., 2023 ) , and by speaker cosine between the speaker embeddings of the two stems, which equals 1.00 for a duplicated stem. Lower cosine means more distinct voices; a silent stem also lowers it but scores an own-line word error near 1.0, so the two are read together. CLAP scores use LAION-CLAP with the HTSAT-base audio encoder and the music_speech_audioset_epoch_15_esc_89.98 checkpoint; transcripts come from Whisper large-v3 (faster-whisper); speaker embeddings are the x-vectors of microsoft/wavlm-base-plus-sv . Judge shares the PE-AV (Perception Encoder, audio-visual) encoder family with the SAM Audio separator, and AudioSep’s query encoder is the scorer’s CLAP checkpoint, which inflates its CLAP-derived columns. CLAP identity places the audio-mix returned twice close to a real method (0.12 on the sounds lane, against 0.07 for silence), whereas swap margin places both controls at 0.00; the headline claims therefore rest on margins. The reference-stem evaluation of Section F adds two waveform-level measures.
paragraphs.zh: 令 J⁡(s,c) 表示在给定描述 c 和输入音频混合信号时，SAM Audio Judge 对音轨 s 的整体评分，而 C⁡(s,c) 表示音轨与描述之间的 CLAP 余弦值（Shi et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2023）。 对于包含音轨 s₁,s₂ 和描述 c₁,c₂ 的片段，身份评分为 J⁡(sᵢ,cᵢ) 和 C⁡(sᵢ,cᵢ)，交换余差则为 J⁡(sᵢ,cᵢ)−J⁡(sᵢ,cⱼ) 和 C⁡(sᵢ,cᵢ)−C⁡(sᵢ,cⱼ)（其中 j≠i），并对所有音轨取平均（J-swap、C-swap）；若某音轨完全复制了音频混合信号，其交换余差为零。 语音音轨的评分基于本行词错误率，即每个音轨转录文本与其对应说话人引用台词之间的词错误率（Radford et al., 2023），以及两个音轨说话人嵌入向量之间的说话人余弦值；若为重复音轨，该余弦值为 1.00。 余弦值越低表示声音越不同；静音音轨也会降低该值，但其本行词错误率接近 1.0，因此两者需结合解读。 CLAP 评分使用 LAION-CLAP，搭配 HTSAT-base 音频编码器和 music_speech_audioset_epoch_15_esc_89.98 检查点；转录文本来自 Whisper large-v3（faster-whisper）；说话人嵌入向量则来自 microsoft/wavlm-base-plus-sv 的 x-vector。 Judge 与 SAM Audio separator 共享 PE-AV（感知编码器，视听）编码器家族，而 AudioSep 的查询编码器正是评分器的 CLAP 检查点，这会放大其源自 CLAP 的列值。 CLAP 身份评分将两次返回的音频混合信号置于接近真实方法的位置（声音通道为 0.12，静音时为 0.07），而交换余差则使两个对照值均为 0.00；因此，主要结论依赖于交换余差。 第 F 节中参考音轨的评估增加了两种波形层面的指标。

paragraphs.en: Separation tables report mean ± \pm standard deviation over seeds { 0 , 1 , 2 } \{0,1,2\} , and SAM-Audio-bench over { 0 , … , 4 } \{0,\dots,4\} ; a seed redraws each method against the same fixed audio-mix, and AudioSep, being deterministic, enters as one draw, and its word-error spread reflects recognizer variation alone. On the generation benchmark a seed re-runs the entire experiment, so the spread also carries the variation of the generated audio-mix. Every p p is a Holm-corrected paired Wilcoxon test within its stated family. Whisper transcription is not deterministic (pass-to-pass spread up to 0.08 own-line word error), so word-error comparisons are made within one recognizer pass. Tables report mean ± \pm SD over these seeds, best in bold and second underlined; stars on a baseline cell give the significance of SepGen against it at the weakest seed: *** p < 0.001 p<0.001 , ** p < 0.01 p<0.01 , * p < 0.05 p<0.05 , ns not significant.

paragraphs.en: Each study uses ten clips, each with one caption per source to be recovered, and the listener answers one question per caption. The separation study draws four clips from the Veo benchmark and six from SAM-Audio-bench, and the generation study ten clips of the generation benchmark at seed 0. For separation, SepGen contributes one draw per clip at a randomly drawn seed, and SAM Audio its best-of-eight output, reranked by its own ranker: SAM Audio large with our captions on the Veo clips, and SAM Audio large-tv with the native captions on SAM-Audio-bench. For every clip, the listener watches the reference video with its unseparated soundtrack, then hears the two candidate stems of a caption, one per method, and picks the better one, with a tie option. The question asks which candidate is better overall, judged on faithfulness, separation, and alignment with the text description, all three explained on the instruction page. The candidates are anonymous, and the order of the clips and of the two players is drawn independently for every listener and every source, so nothing on the page reveals a method. One source per study is a screening question whose better candidate is obvious, which detects listeners who answer without listening; a listener who misses it is discarded in full, and that source is excluded from the figure, since the remaining listeners all answered it identically. We recruited on the Prolific platform and kept 48 listeners for separation, after two missed the screening question, and 51 for generation. The ten separation clips carry 16 sources, one the screening question, giving 48 × 15 = 720 48\times 15=720 judgements, and the ten generation clips carry two stems each, one of them the screening question, giving 51 × ( 10 × 2 − 1 ) = 969 51\times(10\times 2-1)=969 judgements. Participants consented to taking part, gave no personal data beyond an anonymous platform identifier, and were paid a fixed fee.
paragraphs.zh: 每项研究均使用十个片段，每个片段对应一个需要恢复的源音频，听者需针对每个字幕回答一个问题。 分离研究从 Veo 基准中抽取四个片段，从 SAM-Audio-bench 中抽取六个片段；生成研究则使用生成基准在种子为 0 时的十个片段。 在分离任务中，SepGen 对每个片段以随机抽取的种子生成一次结果，而 SAM Audio 则提供其八次输出中的最佳结果，并由其自身的排序器重新排序：对于 Veo 片段，使用带有我们字幕的 SAM Audio large；对于 SAM-Audio-bench，则使用带有原生字幕的 SAM Audio large-tv。 对于每个片段，听者先观看参考视频及其未经分离的原声带，然后听到某个字幕对应的两个候选音轨（每种方法提供一个），并从中选择更优的一个，同时可以选择平局选项。 问题要求判断哪个候选音轨整体表现更佳，评判标准包括对原始音频的忠实度、分离效果以及与文本描述的一致性，这三个标准均在说明页面上进行了解释。 候选音轨均为匿名呈现，且对于每位听者和每个源音频，片段及两个候选音轨的顺序均独立抽取，因此页面上的任何信息都无法揭示所用方法。 每项研究中有一个源音频作为筛选问题，其更优的候选音轨显而易见，用于识别未认真聆听即作答的听者；若听者答错该问题，则其全部结果将被舍弃，且该源音频将排除在图表之外，因为其余所有听者的答案均完全一致。 我们通过 Prolific 平台招募参与者，在分离研究中，有两人未能通过筛选问题，最终保留 48 名听者；生成研究则保留了 51 名听者。 十个分离片段共包含 16 个源音频（其中一个为筛选问题），由此产生 48 × 15 = 720 次判断；十个生成片段每个包含两个音轨（其中一个为筛选问题），由此产生 51 × (10 × 2 − 1) = 969 次判断。 参与者已同意参与研究，除一个匿名平台标识符外未提供任何个人数据，并获得固定报酬。

paragraphs.en: Table S4 repeats Table 1 of the main paper with seed spreads, paired-test stars, and three degenerate controls, and Table S5 splits the sounds lane by scene category: the Judge and swap-margin leads hold in every category and are widest on music, where two instruments sound for the whole clip and a cascade has no silent span to exploit. paragraphs.en: Generating each source in its single-caption pass, without a shared audio-mix channel, collapses both lanes (Table S6 ): nothing binds the two scenes, so Judge falls below every cascade baseline that receives the joint audio-mix; the within-architecture cascade on LTX-2.3 is in Table 4 of the main paper.

paragraphs.en: Table S7 scores the estimated-separation schedule of the generation stage (Section 3 of the main paper). Starting Estimated Separation at every step ( σ g = σ max \sigma_{g}{=}\sigma_{\max} ) rather than below σ g = 0.97 \sigma_{g}{=}0.97 lowers J-swap at equal Judge and word error, because the stems then read a clean estimate of an audio-mix that has not yet committed to its sources; using it at no step ( σ g = 0 \sigma_{g}{=}0 ) lowers J-swap and raises word error while Judge rises, so the schedule purchases isolation of each speaker’s line rather than sound quality. paragraphs.en: SI-SDR compares a stem with a reference sample by sample. It suits mask-based separators such as AudioSep, which filter the audio-mix. Generative separators synthesize a new waveform. Our audio VAE decoder, for example, regenerates the fine time structure of each stem from its latent. Passing each method’s stems once through the decoder and scoring every input against its round trip (Table S14 ) makes SI-SDR negative for every method while envelope correlation stays high and LSD low: the decoder reproduces energy and spectrum while rewriting the waveform. Restoring the original short-time phase alone makes SI-SDR positive again, whereas restoring the original magnitudes alone barely moves it, so the loss lies in the resynthesized phase and we score separation with phase-invariant measures. The bottom block of Table S14 scores each method’s summed stems against its audio-mix by the same measures; a low SI-SDR there is expected for decoder-resynthesized stems, and envelope correlation and LSD are the operative columns.

paragraphs.en: We track each source in the image from the attention of its stem, with no extra training or detector. Each stem has two attention maps: one between the video and the words of its caption, and one from the video to the stem’s audio. We average both over the 30 separation steps and blocks 26 to 33 and 36, and keep the map that gives the more stable track. In each frame we take the weighted geometric median of its strongest 2% and smooth the track with a Kalman smoother.
